section: Condition: Hospitalization — Royal Neighbors Ensured Legacy
exactWording: if not currently hospitalized or havent been hospitalized for 2 weeks total in the past 12 months: level 1st day product
whyUnclear: Typos ("havent") and ambiguous double-negative logic — unclear whether "level 1st day product" is Preferred/Level or a separate product tier, and how the OR combines with the Guaranteed Issue bullets above it.

exactWording: Depression block lists Preferred / medication compliance only; Hospitalization is a separate condition with its own carrier rules.
whyUnclear: Nick's video walks through "depression + hospitalized" as one case, but the rules doc never ties psych hospitalization lookbacks to the Depression section. Unclear whether agents should apply both condition blocks independently or if depression-related hospitalization should use different lookbacks.

exactWording: If A1C is 8%–8.6%: SimpliNow Legacy Max. If A1C is less than 8%: SimpliNow Legacy Max. If A1C is not between 8.7%–9.9%: Decline. If A1C is 8.7%–9.9%: SimpliNow Legacy
whyUnclear: Conflicting bands: A1C under 8% and 8–8.6% say Legacy Max, but "If A1C is not between 8.7%–9.9%: Decline" would also decline those same readings.
